t2.thesis: After a 63% 12-month run and a 12% upward revision to Q3 EPS estimates, TXN's October print mostly comes down to its Q4 guide, which is seasonally soft, so a beat on Q3 may not be enough to lift the next open above the entry open.
reasons: Semis cluster base rate is below 50% (0.479)
Q3 EPS estimate rose ~12% over 90 days (2.16 to 2.43), so the bar is high
TXN's own history: Q4 guides are seasonally weaker (I5) and its October reactions have often been negative, e.g. -8.6% in Oct 2025
Options lean bearish: put/call volume 3.2x and call-minus-put IV of -0.03
Last print beat EPS by 10% and the stock still fell 2.8%, so beats are already priced in
t2.deciding_variable: The Q4 revenue guide midpoint versus consensus, and the commentary on whether the industrial and auto recovery is sustained.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster semis t0_hit 0.479 (n=434); overall ~0.54 and AMC 0.538 are higher, but the cluster is the closest reference class

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That report is from today (2026-10-21), after my training cutoff, so I have no information on how TXN's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 3 points from 0.48. Raised estimates, a seasonally soft Q4 guide, a strong run-up and bearish options flow outweigh the strong fundamental momentum (23% revenue growth, margin expansion) and a recent tech rebound.

theses.mechanism: Q3 beats, but the Q4 guide midpoint comes in at or below consensus on seasonal softness, and the stock sells off after its run-up.
theses.wrong_if: The Q4 guide implies flat-to-up sequential revenue, well above normal seasonality.

theses.mechanism: Industrial and data-center strength carries through, and an above-seasonal Q4 guide confirms the recovery has staying power.
theses.wrong_if: Management flags distributor inventory builds or slowing orders.

theses.mechanism: An in-line print and guide leave the stock near the entry open, with the result decided by market drift and Lam Research's same-night reaction.
theses.wrong_if: Guide or margin surprises exceed the ~7% implied move.

key_observations: Q4 revenue and EPS guide midpoints vs ~consensus
Gross margin trend and capex/depreciation commentary
Industrial and auto sequential growth; data center commentary
Silicon Labs deal financing or timing updates
LRCX reaction the same night as sector read-through
